user.title: Choose your TC66C
user.description:
Close the TC66C web page first: the meter accepts only one connection.

{likely} likely meter(s) (marked ★) out of {total} connectable Bluetooth devices. Pick one, or enter the MAC address yourself.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name} ({address}) as TC66C? BT24-M is a generic module name, so check this is the meter.

error.invalid_address: Choose a device or enter a valid MAC address.

init.title: Settings
init.description:
How often the meter is read, and when a charge session starts and ends. A session starts when the current reaches the threshold and ends when it stays below it for the end delay (or the meter is gone that long).

Retry: normally HA connects as soon as a proxy hears the meter again. As a fallback it also tries every this many minutes without a new advertisement (0 = off). The Reconnect button on the device page does it right away.
